title: Christoph loves Treehouse - Dean’s List Interview
content:
<html><head></head><body>As you may already know, I am a huge fan of Treehouse. For those of you who haven't heard about them, Treehouse is a coding learn-platform by Ryan Carson and a lot of other great people. I am honored to got the chance to share some of my experiences on their blog.
            </body></html>
